## Description

Extends the gateway tickets: UPI AutoPay mandate for packages (the patient approves once in their UPI app, 24 h pre-debit notice, cancel any time), a secure pay link sent by WhatsApp with the amount filled and no health details in the message, Apple Pay and Google Pay in the UAE. Marked paid only on the gateway's confirmed webhook. Needed by the patient app payment sheet (MDV-P5-037).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a pay link is sent, when the WhatsApp message is read, then it shows only the clinic name and amount.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given an AutoPay charge is due, when 24 hours before, then the patient is reminded.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the gateway has not confirmed, when the desk looks at the invoice, then it is not marked paid.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
